decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet display draws directly on the firm's core cardboard display know-how and in-house R&D, so it can be refined rather than abandoned, though its absence from the website in 2020–2021 raises the risk that it has faded from the active range.

The pegboard-back shelf display is a small variation the firm's design staff can readily adapt to customer feedback, but its disappearance from the website makes withdrawal nearly as likely as continuation.
The standard quarter-pallet shelf display is a core format built on existing knowledge and production capacity, so it is the most likely to be retained despite not being shown online recently.

Although the media display uses familiar cardboard know-how, the shrinking media segment and its absence from the website since 2020 suggest the firm gains little new learning from it, so the resources are better redeployed.
